properties.notes: Erection of second and third floor extension to building referred to as Barclay House to provide 9 residential duplex apartments (7 x 2bed and 2 x 3bed) and the change of use of the ground floor from storage space to office (Use B1a) and gymnasium (Use class D2). Refurbishment of building referred to as Stadium House to provide office space (Use class B1a) at ground floor and creation of new mezzanine level, creation of a new extension linking both buildings at ground floor level and provision for car (stacked storage) & cycle parking space and bin stores
